# Hive: a straw skep of six stacked, tapering rings on a low stump, a dark entrance at the front.
# Generated by make_env.py. Up Z, front -Y.
new
material new Straw --base-color 1.0000 0.5059 0.2588 --no-slot
material new Wood --base-color 0.6706 0.1216 0.3961 --no-slot
material new Hole --base-color 0.1686 0.0588 0.3294 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Stump --vertices 9 --radius 0.55 --depth 0.52 --location 0 0 0.26
material assign Wood
add mesh cylinder --name Ring0 --vertices 10 --radius 0.55 --depth 0.2 --location 0 0 0.62
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
scale 0.86 0.86 1
mode object
add mesh cylinder --name Ring1 --vertices 10 --radius 0.56 --depth 0.2 --location 0 0 0.82
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
scale 0.86 0.86 1
mode object
add mesh cylinder --name Ring2 --vertices 10 --radius 0.52 --depth 0.2 --location 0 0 1.02
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
scale 0.86 0.86 1
mode object
add mesh cylinder --name Ring3 --vertices 10 --radius 0.44 --depth 0.2 --location 0 0 1.2
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
scale 0.86 0.86 1
mode object
add mesh cylinder --name Ring4 --vertices 10 --radius 0.32 --depth 0.2 --location 0 0 1.36
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
scale 0.86 0.86 1
mode object
add mesh cylinder --name Ring5 --vertices 10 --radius 0.17 --depth 0.2 --location 0 0 1.48
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
scale 0.86 0.86 1
mode object
select Ring0 Ring1 Ring2 Ring3 Ring4 Ring5
active Ring0
join
rename Ring0 Skep
material assign Straw
add mesh cube --name Hole --size 1 --location 0 -0.5 0.66
scale 0.26 0.14 0.18
apply --scale
material assign Hole
shade flat
select all
shade flat
export hive.glb
